title: Qualcomm buys CPU designer Nuvia for about $1.4B

sources.quote: Acquisitions On March 16, 2021 (the Closing Date), we completed the acquisition of NuVia, Inc. (NUVIA) for $1.1 billion (net of cash acquired), substantially all of which was paid in cash.

explain: Qualcomm bought Nuvia, a startup founded by former Apple chip designers, to build its own high-performance processors. It was announced at about $1.4B; Qualcomm's filing shows $1.1B net of Nuvia's cash, the amount shown.
